title: Connect AI models and providers
summary: Register the AI models the platform's agents use — OpenAI, Google Gen AI, LTX or another provider — and set retry behaviour.
bodyMd:
The platform's AI agents and skills call models through integrations you register under Platform Admin. Each integration names a model, its provider and the provider's base URL, and holds the credential the platform uses to call it. Every call runs from inside your own AWS account.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with the Admin role.
  • An API key from the provider, with access to the model you want to register. Providers seen in the platform include Open AI, Google Gen AI and LTX.

Add an integration

  1. In the left navigation, select Platform Admin.
  2. Under Enabled Features, select AI Models / Integrations.
  3. Select + Create Integration.
  4. Enter a Name you will recognise when assigning it to a skill, for example GPT 5.2.
  5. Enter the Model identifier exactly as the provider publishes it, for example gpt-5.2, gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview, veo-3.1-generate-preview or ltx-2-5-pro.
  6. Choose the Provider.
  7. Enter the Base URL, for example https://api.openai.com/v1 for Open AI or https://generativeai.googleapis.com/v1 for Google Gen AI.
  8. Enter the provider's API key.
  9. Save the integration.

Set retry behaviour

  1. In the Integration Settings card, enter Max Retries — how many times a failed model call is retried, for example 3.
  2. Enter the Retry Interval between retries in seconds, for example 2.
  3. Select Save changes.

Verify it worked

The integration appears as a row in the table with its Name, Model, Provider and Base URL. It is now available to choose in the AI Model / Integration column under AI Agents / Skills.

Troubleshooting

Campaign brief or creative generation fails

Cause. The model's API key is invalid, or the base URL or model identifier does not match what the provider expects.

Fix. Open the integration's ⋮ menu, check the model identifier and base URL against the provider's documentation, and re-enter the key.
